import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int M = 32;
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXD = 64;
    static final int MAXK = 32;

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] a = new int[M][M];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    a[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] getRow(int i) {
            return a[i];
        }

        static Matrix multiply(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
            Matrix r = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < M; k++) {
                        r.a[i][j] = add(r.a[i][j], mul(a.a[i][k], b.a[k][j]));
                    }
                }
            }
            return r;
        }
    }

    static int add(int a, int b) {
        return a + b >= mod ? a + b - mod : a + b;
    }

    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int) (((long) a * b) % mod);
    }

    static Matrix calcMatrix(int n, int off, int k, Matrix[] f) {
        Matrix ans = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                int ni = (i == k) ? i : (i + off) % k;
                int nj = (j == k) ? j : (j + off) % k;
                ans.a[ni][nj] = f[n].a[i][j];
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int sumDigits(long n, int k) {
        int ans = 0;
        while (n > 0) {
            ans += n % k;
            n /= k;
        }
        return ans % k;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        int ndigits = 0;
        long tmp = n;
        while (tmp > 0) {
            tmp /= k;
            ndigits++;
        }

        Matrix[] f = new Matrix[MAXD];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXD; i++) {
            f[i] = new Matrix();
        }

        // Initialize identity matrix
        Matrix id = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            id.a[i][i] = 1;
        }

        // Initialize f[0]
        f[0] = id;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            f[0].a[i][0] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < ndigits; i++) {
            f[i] = id;
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                f[i] = Matrix.multiply(f[i], calcMatrix(i - 1, j, k, f));
            }
        }

        long cur = 0;
        long pw = 1;

        ndigits--;
        for (int i = 0; i < ndigits; i++) {
            pw *= k;
        }

        Matrix ans = new Matrix();
        // Initialize ans as identity
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            ans.a[i][i] = 1;
        }

        while (cur < n) {
            if (ndigits >= 0) {
                while (cur + pw <= n) {
                    ans = Matrix.multiply(ans, calcMatrix(ndigits, (int) sumDigits(cur, k), k, f));
                    cur += pw;
                }
                pw /= k;
                ndigits--;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }

        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            sum = add(sum, ans.a[k][i]);
        }
        System.out.println(sum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
